0022600155.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-4, on a three-game skid) for the Nets' sixth game of the season, with Brooklyn 0-3 at home and 0-2 on the road, fifth in the Atlantic and 15th in the East, while Indiana sits third in the Central and 12th in the East. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with Aaron Nesmith and Obi Toppin listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The Nets trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 136-109 in Brooklyn on October 25, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
